# Brand art

The files here are the owner's own art, committed with the owner's permission, and are not
under the code's licence: `mark.svg` (the one-colour mark), `emblem.webp` (the full-colour
emblem) and `crew.webp` (the crew illustration on Home). `wordmark.svg` is the word
"whizbang" drawn as outlines from Roboto Slab at weight 900, under the Apache License 2.0
(`ui/licences/roboto-slab.txt`, and its row in `THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md`); no font file
ships.
